title: Learning Transverse Momentum Distributions from Raw Scattering Events via Conditional Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2608.27077v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Extracting transverse momentum dependent parton distribution functions (TMD PDFs) from semi-inclusive deep inelastic scattering (SIDIS) data is a central goal of the nucleon structure program at Jefferson Lab and the future Electron-Ion Collider. Traditional extraction methods rely on parameterized functional forms and iterative fitting, which can limit the flexibility of the resulting distributions and make uncertainty quantification cumbersome. We present a conditional diffusion model that learns to map raw SIDIS event kinematics directly to TMD PDFs, bypassing explicit functional assumptions. Evaluated on simulated SIDIS data at CLAS12 kinematics, the model recovers the underlying TMD with informative uncertainties that narrow steadily with increasing event statistics, and produces reliable estimates even with as few as 1,000 conditioning events, a statistics-limited regime directly relevant to ongoing and planned experiments.

translated_title: 通过条件扩散从原始散射事件学习横向动量分布
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.27077v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：从半包容深度非弹性散射（SIDIS）数据中提取横向动量依赖的部分子分布函数（TMD PDFs）是杰斐逊实验室和未来电子-离子对撞机核子结构项目的核心目标。传统提取方法依赖于参数化函数形式和迭代拟合，这可能限制所得分布的灵活性，并使不确定性量化变得繁琐。我们提出了一种条件扩散模型，该模型学习直接将原始SIDIS事件运动学映射到TMD PDFs，绕过了显式函数假设。在CLAS12运动学下的模拟SIDIS数据上评估，该模型恢复了底层TMD，并提供了信息丰富的不确定性，这些不确定性随事件统计量的增加而稳步缩小，即使仅有1,000个条件事件（一个与正在进行和计划实验直接相关的统计受限区域），也能产生可靠估计。
tldr: 本文提出了一种条件扩散模型，直接从原始SIDIS散射事件学习横向动量依赖的部分子分布函数，无需显式函数假设，并在低统计量下仍能提供可靠估计和有效的不确定性量化。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a conditional diffusion model that learns transverse momentum dependent parton distribution functions directly from raw SIDIS scattering events, bypassing explicit functional assumptions, and delivers reliable estimates with informative uncertainties even under low statistics.
